title: Guard enforcement

conformance.reason: Task 26.3 adds machine enforcement (reports-array completeness; phase aggregate consistency; scope self-check) to scripts/check-agents.sh. It depends on no unverified Jellyfin or provider behavior, changes no product behavior, and implements no ADR clause. No pre-dispatch specialist conformance check applies.

rework.closure: Attempt 1's test-quality audit (PASS_WITH_FINDINGS) found: TQ-01 the new B1 check had narrowed the pre-existing all-phases reviewer-report listing requirement to phase 20; TQ-02 role_mix was computed over task-record invocations only while subagent_invocations_total includes phase-reviewer entries (inconsistent with the phase-20 worked example); TQ-03 a phase-reviewer invocation omitted from subagents was undetectable. Attempt 2 restored the ungated all-phases check as a separate section, recomputed role_mix over the union of task-record and phase-record phase-reviewer invocations, and added a from-phase-26 requirement that a phase-review*.json implies at least one phase-reviewer entry with an equal phase_reviewer_invocations. Attempt-1 implementation review also aborted with no report (recorded as attempt 0) and was re-run against the reworked tree.
rework.evidence: docs/implementation/26.3/worker-report.attempt-2.json; docs/implementation/26.3/test-quality-review.attempt-2.json (APPROVED, TQ-01/02/03 genuinely closed); docs/implementation/26.3/reviewer-report.json (APPROVED, all three resolved).

rework.closure: The phase-26 review found the from-phase-26 aggregate guard double-counts a phase-reviewer invocation recorded inside a task record (26.6 is the first such task record), so the semantically correct phase-26 aggregate failed the guard. Attempt 3 recomputes from the de-duplicated union of task-record invocations and the phase record's own phase-reviewer entries keyed by (role, execution.session_id, attempt): counts and role_mix over the set, task_level_* over task records, phase_reviewer_* over phase-only entries, and the presence/equality check over the distinct phase-reviewer count. The guard comment and the contract A5 bullet state the rule.
rework.evidence: docs/implementation/26.3/worker-report.attempt-3.json rework[0]; probes: semantically correct 17/2 aggregate PASS; double-count 18/3 FAIL; task-record-only 16/1 PASS; phases 20 (13/2) and 21 (56/0) still reconcile at constant 20.

notes: scripts/check-agents.sh now enforces: an ungated all-phases reviewer-report listing; from phase 20 the on-disk base/attempt evidence completeness; from phase 26 the phase aggregate consistency with a subagents array and a reconciling aggregate over the de-duplicated invocation set (counts and role_mix over the set; task-level plus phase-only sums; exact token/duration integers; COST_TOLERANCE_USD=1e-6 for cost) plus the phase-reviewer-presence/equality requirement; and the AGGREGATE_APPLIES_FROM_PHASE=26 scope self-check. docs/agent-contracts.md A5 was adjusted to name the two rules, the recomputation basis, and the de-duplication key, and docs/plan/README.md's reports-array paraphrase was aligned.

Attempt 3 was a resumed-session invocation on attempt 2's session id; this record carries its own delta so the phase aggregate sums the true totals. All three review rounds (implementation attempt 1, test-quality attempt 1/2) APPROVED the attempt-2 state; the phase review found the attempt-3 defect and its re-review is the phase-26 gate re-run.

Carried non-blocking notes: the scope self-checks are bare phrase greps (drift fails loud, never silent); docs/agent-contracts.md sits exactly at its 220-line budget. The phase-26 aggregate branch is currently exercised only by fabricated fixtures; the first real exercise is the phase-26 gate record.
